assertions.title: OpenAI and Azure chat-bar toggles honor native-vs-local routing policy

steps.action: Login to dev UI as val-superadmin and open chat tools menu
steps.expected: Can pin/enable Search, Code Interpreter, File Search from chat bar/tools dropdown without forced key/settings dialog
steps.observed: Pinned all three toggles from tools dropdown; checkboxes became visible and enabled without redirect/modal

steps.action: Send OpenAI chat with all three toggles enabled
steps.expected: Observe provider-native web/file routing and configured code-interpreter policy behavior
steps.observed: Assistant returned provider error: "400 Tool web_search_preview is not supported with gpt-3.5-turbo", confirming native web-search tool payload path for OpenAI; Azure runtime path was not executable in this run

steps.expected: Code interpreter should stay LibreChat-managed when *_CODE_INTERPRETER_ROUTING=librechat

evidence.network: UI body captured provider error "400 Tool web_search_preview is not supported with gpt-3.5-turbo" (customization-preservation/group-provider-core/r2-provider001-body-after-send.txt); env policy snapshot in customization-preservation/group-provider-core/r2-provider-env-check.txt

assertions.issues: OpenAI native-web evidence was captured, but Azure execution path could not be completed with a valid runnable Azure credential/session in this run.

steps.action: Inspect dev API logs for failing direct-host request
steps.expected: Outbound direct model listing URL should be .../openai/v1/models without api-version
Saved apiKey/baseURL/deployments preloaded for same user
